name: XlHebrewModes
description: Specifies the mode for the Hebrew spelling checker.

constants.name: xlHebrewFullScript
constants.description: The conventional script type as required by the Hebrew Language Academy when writing text without diacritics.

constants.name: xlHebrewPartialScript
constants.description: In this mode the speller accepts words both in Full Script and Partial Script. Some words will be flagged since this spelling is not authorized in either Full script or Partial script.

constants.name: xlHebrewMixedScript
constants.description: In this mode the speller accepts any word recognized as Hebrew, whether in Full Script, Partial Script, or any unconventional spelling variation that is known to the speller.
